rul.dataset: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 (turbofan jet engine, NOT automotive)
rul.preprocessing: StandardScaler (fit on train split only), zero-variance sensors dropped
rul.split_strategy: unit-level (engine-level) split, no row leakage across a trajectory

anomaly.dataset: SYNTHETIC demo_vehicle_telemetry.csv (EngineAD real data not included in provided materials; see docs/dataset_sources.md)
anomaly.preprocessing: StandardScaler (fit on healthy-scenario training subset), rolling mean/std/rate feature engineering
anomaly.protocol: One-class: trained on healthy segment only, evaluated on full labeled set
